SELECT t.dev_team_id, t.organization_id, t.testing_location_id, t.owner_user_id, t.name, t.description, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dev_team_members m WHERE m.dev_team_id = t.dev_team_id AND m.start_date <= NOW() AND (m.end_date IS NULL OR m.end_date > NOW())) AS members_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM lambdas b WHERE b.dev_team_id = t.dev_team_id) AS lambdas_count FROM dev_teams t
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dev_team_members um WHERE um.dev_team_id = t.dev_team_id AND um.user_id = #{userId} AND um.start_date <= NOW() AND (um.end_date IS NULL OR um.end_date > NOW()))
ORDER BY t.dev_team_id

SELECT l.* FROM dev_team_locations g JOIN dev_teams t ON t.dev_team_id = g.dev_team_id JOIN locations l ON l.location_id = g.location_id AND l.organization_id = t.organization_id WHERE g.dev_team_id = #{devTeamId} AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.location_type = 'TESTING' ORDER BY l.location_id

SELECT t.* FROM dev_team_locations g JOIN dev_teams t ON t.dev_team_id = g.dev_team_id JOIN locations l ON l.location_id = g.location_id AND l.organization_id = t.organization_id WHERE g.location_id = #{locationId} AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.location_type = 'TESTING' ORDER BY t.dev_team_id

SELECT t.dev_team_id, t.organization_id, t.testing_location_id, t.owner_user_id, t.name, t.description, m.user_id, m.start_date, m.end_date, b.lambda_id, b.name AS lambda_name, b.description AS lambda_description FROM dev_teams t LEFT OUTER JOIN dev_team_members m ON m.dev_team_id = t.dev_team_id LEFT OUTER JOIN lambdas b ON b.dev_team_id = t.dev_team_id WHERE t.dev_team_id = #{devTeamId} ORDER BY m.user_id, b.lambda_id

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dev_team_members m WHERE dev_team_id = #{devTeamId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u JOIN dev_teams t ON t.organization_id = u.organization_id WHERE u.user_id = m.user_id AND t.dev_team_id = m.dev_team_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.account_type = 'DEVELOPER') AND start_date <= NOW() AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date > NOW()))
